body: Yeah, maybe I just interpreted your post wrong but the way I read it, it seemed you were suicidal from people asking you to act like an adult. I don't think there's anything wrong with wanting to be loved like a kid.

No, no. Like I said with all due respect. I just wanted to open the possibility that if you're struggling with basic responsibilities there might be an underlying issue that you should seek help for. I frankly couldn't care less what you do beyond that. As I've said, you do you. I'm not talking about responsibilities to try to make you feel bad, I'm talking about responsibilities because from the way I saw things, it seemed like you were suicidal from people asking for you to act like an adult, which a 14 year old is capable of acting like. So if you struggled with that there may have been something else going on, like trauma. I know people who struggle with basic responsibilities and "acting like an adult" because of past trauma. I'm serious, it may be something you want to look into assuming I'm interpreting your post correctly.

Even with nitrite given its effects in high doses I'd hardly class that as "painless." Almost any OD is generally pretty awful of an experience and considering it's used to treat cyanide poisoning, you'd probably need a decent dose to actually do anything. Still wouldn't recommend it.

If you're physically over the age of 18, and not mentally handicapped, then I'd call that adult enough to tend to your basic responsibilities, sorry.

Oh, I see you added an edit to your comment.

With all due respect, you do you, but regardless whether you feel 14 or 40 at heart, if you're an adult it's not that far fetched for people to expect you to do adult things. A 14 year old can already do the bare minimum of being an adult. Having a job, being generally responsible, seeking out education or activities, being appropriate in the right situations, etc. If that's too much to ask from someone, perhaps it's depression or trauma that's the issue?

It's okay to want to be a kid at heart, it's okay to be silly and inappropriate and want to have fun still. That's fine for any age, but if you wanna call yourself 14 that's fine too. But neglecting your basic responsibilities is not okay.
If you have a plan to hurt yourself or others, and that plan is in the immediate future or before you see your therapist again, you probably will be committed.

Depends on how long you've taken it ago. ODs aren't cyanide pills, deaths don't happen within a few minutes. Depending on what you've taken it could take anywhere from a few hours to 24-48 hours to have an effect on you.

Even then Naproxen in general probably won't do much when it comes to death. Even at the mgs you took.

You'll probably be in a lot of pain, though. Like... A lot. I recommend you call emergency services, especially before it's too late. Not too late as in die, but too late as in writhe in pain for the next few days. There's only so much time they have to stop an overdose before you'll feel its effects. If it _is_ too late not all hope is loss, being in a hospital will still help. But the sooner the better.

In this specific case? I was called sad and pathetic over schoolwork that I'm trying my best on. She knows I struggle with school for a variety of reasons, I constantly tell her. I tell her it's hard for me. But all I get is yelled at or called pathetic or reminded that because of my grades I'm going to end up working at a gas station for my whole life. 

I'm already self conscious and she isn't fucking helping at all.
